rule: During the frozen educational phase, failures may repair the EXPERIMENT but may not expand Torin's cognitive implementation.
may_be_repaired: an exam that leaks an answer
a harness that bypasses the production ingress
a metric that cannot report failure
a database or process state that does not reset
may_not_be_repaired: Torin cannot parse a legitimate held-out construction
why: Repairing a cognitive capability mid-experiment destroys the distinction between 'Torin learned' and 'we upgraded Torin while teaching it'. A capability Torin cannot acquire through education IS the result.
why_refrozen: Dataflow planning was proved at 08 and had never been RUN. Executing it found three places that could not have carried a runtime value to the world, all of them invisible while the only thing being tested was the plan. Still before any Stage 2 instruction.

change.what: Planning outcomes are named: PROVED_PLAN / CONDITIONAL_PLAN / NO_PROVED_PLAN_WITHIN_BOUND / UNREACHABLE, read off status and guarantee together, so a plan that computed every value it needs and one that will not know its result until it runs stop being the same answer.
change.effect: A learned program runs end to end against a real world through real tools -- copy_file and run_python -- over a file the substrate has never read. Planned blind (the plan carries pending_read and pending_multiply, not numbers), executed for real, each step binding what the step before it actually produced. 17 -> TEXT(17) -> NUMBER(17) -> PRODUCT(34) -> a file on disk holding 34. Zero model calls, and the plan survives a restart carrying only serialisable data because the bindings are recoverable from the world rather than remembered.
change.unlocked: Torin can construct and execute programs whose intermediate values do not exist until earlier steps actually run. The negative control holds the line: a file containing `hello` makes the parse tool succeed and the world refuse, the rule is CONTRADICTED, and the multiply that would have consumed it refuses by naming the precondition that does not hold -- no value is invented to keep going.
also_repaired: rule_store.validate kept its own copy of 'did the world do what the rule predicted' and it had drifted to a subset test, so EVERY rule whose output the world supplies was REFUTED by held-out evidence of it working. One owner now: rule_induction.derives / contradicted_by

effect_verification judged a prediction naming no particular value by exact membership, so 'reading produces some text' was contradicted by text appearing. Such a prediction is now checked against what CHANGED, and is UNKNOWN rather than confirmed where the prior world was not supplied
state_plan_to_tasks dropped the domain, and the executor looks a tool up by (domain, predicate) — so every task built from a learned plan refused with 'no tool bound', whatever was bound

verification.negative_control: `hello` -> parse tool succeeds, world holds no NUMBER, rule CONTRADICTED, multiply refuses, no PRODUCT, no output file
